reply_text:
I told Dana it's Dock 38, which they told me on 14 Oct is their dock for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups from then on. I replied in our DM.

The answer came from our DM history, not from the saved memory. Asking GBrain for Dana's facts returned nothing, even though I saved this one yesterday as a private note. GBrain's tool docs say remote connections can only read back shared facts, so the private save probably works but can't be read back from here. If it can't, private facts saved this way are lost to me, and only the DM thread holds them.

To make DM requests like this reliable to recall, one of two things needs to change. Either the brain owner gives this connection access to private facts, or these get saved as shared, which other members could then see.
